facts.fact: Pell Orlan is the Taravan survey office rival who would get the Chief Surveyor's chair if Ila's winter map fails; he has drawn three hills from a window.
Ila wrote to the Taravan archive last autumn and the clerk refused the Shilak Cairn file by letter (Ila stayed in Neshar).
Varun is described in Kiran's words as Rohan's old lieutenant who sold the regent every road he guarded.
